authorization: User confirmed PLAN; engineering implementation only; no training or production writes
data_scope: Synthetic images, analytic fields, and fixed read-only training prefixes (hand first64 saved CSV rows with original reference; stage point0 first16 saved CSV rows with before_contact reference). Real raw matching is UNVERIFIED_REFERENCE, provides no model tensor and cannot authorize training. No reserved-test files or scores.

e2.input: same native-postprocessed 69x82x2 float32 displacements as E1
e2.mapping: clip UV then continuous [0,255] float32; no rounding
e2.resize: same C++ float32 dimensions; OpenCV INTER_LINEAR float32
e2.state: unchanged old DIS state, smoothing, and native postprocessing

e3.reference: immutable explicitly authorized pre-sequence unloaded reference; sensor/session/hash binding; no after_lift use
e3.dis: same DIS parameters as E1; each forward and reverse solve starts from zero flow; causal reference-current pair only
e3.correction: zero by default; only explicit rigid transform bound to separately approved independent rigid reference calibration
e3.geometry: map both displacement endpoints; units canonical_px until independent physical calibration exists
e3.contact_status: UNKNOWN; no synthetic deformation map is claimed to be a physical contact mask

quality.confidence_interpretation: heuristic engineering score, not a calibrated probability

acceptance.reference_rejection: wrong binding, future timestamp, unapproved hash, after_lift, no unloaded evidence, or no texture must reject
acceptance.test_thresholds_note: Independent pre-execution review tightened ramp limits before any synthetic/real matching run; frozen thereafter. Failures remain failures and are not repaired by threshold tuning

limitations: Synthetic image matching and analytic field checks are engineering evidence, not physical force accuracy.
No target SDK binary tensor parity is claimed.
Reference evidence metadata cannot by itself prove the physical sensor is unloaded.
Quality masks never remove rows from downstream force evaluation.
